title: AutoNEAR · what does NEAR need? (v4, cinematic)

voice.name: Puck
voice.style: Cinematic trailer narration, warm and human, with real feeling that follows each moment on screen. Keep a brisk pace of about two and a half words per second, with natural breaths. Each scene continues straight from the previous one in the same voice.

tokens_note: Numbers only as {{tokens}} resolved from src/data/captured.json (and contracts.json). No typed digits in narration.

scenes.narration: We all want NEAR to grow. But which way? What does the network need right now, and how would we know?
scenes.style: Hushed and curious, close to the microphone, but moving along at a natural pace. Lean into 'which way', then let the last question hang, almost a whisper.

scenes.narration: The answer is already out there. People say it in public, in posts, in issues, in commits. Studying all that by hand takes months. Sometimes a year.
scenes.style: Quiet intensity, a storyteller leaning in, brisk steady pace without dragging. Stretch only the word 'months' a little, then drop to a flat, weary 'Sometimes a year.'

scenes.narration: So we built AutoNEAR. It keeps reading those signals, ranks the products NEAR could use, and moves the best one toward a build. The owner sets the limits.
scenes.style: A sudden lift of energy, bright and proud, goosebumps. Take a breath of silence, announce 'AutoNEAR' like a title card, then warm and brisk. The last sentence is calm and reassuring. Keep a brisk, flowing pace; do not drag.

scenes.narration: {{prod.sourcesOk|W}} sources checked in. {{prod.feeds|W}} feeds. {{prod.evidence|W}} records, each stored with where it came from. Every one becomes a point of light.
scenes.style: Rising momentum at a quick, driving pace. Each number lands within a second, like a drumroll, each one a notch higher, with almost no pause between them. Then wonder and awe on 'point of light', soft and glowing.

scenes.narration: {{prod.scores|W}} scores later, those points pull together into a constellation of {{prod.opportunities|w}} product ideas.
scenes.style: Awe that widens and accelerates gently as the stars connect, then a satisfied, open landing on 'product ideas'. Keep a brisk, flowing pace; do not drag.

scenes.narration: Then the council votes. {{prod.seats|W}} seats, one of them a skeptic, score every idea by their own rules. The vote repeats as evidence arrives. Today, {{prod.winner.word}} earns a go.
scenes.style: Tense and precise like a countdown, quicker with each seat. Sly on 'one of them a skeptic'. Then pure release on 'earns a go': a smile in the voice, bright and triumphant. Keep a brisk, flowing pace; do not drag.

scenes.narration: A go sends in the swarm. Five agents work one product page at once. Copy. Layout. Style. Media. Check. And a page takes shape in front of you.
scenes.style: Fast, electric and playful, energy snapping upward. The five single words land like a beat drop, each crisp and punchy. End with a delighted exhale on 'takes shape'. Keep a brisk, flowing pace; do not drag.

scenes.narration: Beneath it sits a contract build, compiled, tested and given a code fingerprint. {{suites.nearContract.passed|W}} tests pass. The agent deploys only what the owner approved.
scenes.style: Calm, precise, quiet engineering pride, at a brisk flowing pace without dragging. A small emphasis on the number, firm and level on the last sentence.

scenes.tag: PUBLIC TESTNET · DEMO OWNER KEY · AUTOMATED
scenes.narration: Now the agent works on its own, inside the owner's limits. It draws its own gas and deploys approved code. And on NEAR testnet, the vault refused {{testnet.refusalCount|w}} out-of-bounds moves. Over the cap. Refused. Too many deploys. Refused. Wrong template. Refused. Paused. Refused.
scenes.style: Confident freedom first, brisk. Then each 'Refused' lands like a door slamming: flat, hard, immediate, with only a quarter-second of silence before the next. Move quickly; no long pauses.

scenes.tag: RECORDED RUN · FIXTURE INPUTS · MOCKED RPC
scenes.narration: And the owner always has the final word. Hold to approve. Pause or revoke at any moment. A wrong fingerprint is refused. A human stays on the brake.
scenes.style: Warm, grounded and reassuring at a steady brisk pace. A little weight on 'Hold to approve'. A quiet smile on the very last line.

scenes.narration: Next, the community joins in. People will test each build and confirm it before it goes live.
scenes.style: Open, inviting and optimistic, with a smile, as if turning to face the audience. Opens wide on 'joins in'. Keep a brisk, flowing pace; do not drag.

scenes.narration: AutoNEAR. Public signals in. A product you can inspect. A human on the brake. Judges, clone the repo and run the tests.
scenes.style: Proud and resolute. Each short phrase is its own confident beat, with only a brief pause between them. The last line is direct and friendly, a warm invitation.
